definition_en: The ability to attract, develop, retain, and deploy people with the right skills to meet organisational needs.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk menarik, membangun, mengekalkan dan menempatkan orang yang mempunyai kemahiran yang sesuai bagi memenuhi keperluan organisasi.
typical_tasks_en:
• Interview candidates for the new customer service associate positions.
• Identify skill gaps in the marketing team and recommend a training plan.
• Create a succession plan for the store supervisor role.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Temu duga calon untuk jawatan eksekutif khidmat pelanggan baharu.
• Kenal pasti jurang kemahiran dalam pasukan pemasaran dan cadangkan pelan latihan.
• Cipta pelan penggantian untuk peranan penyelia kedai.
inclusion_rules:
• The task involves recruiting, hiring, or onboarding staff
• The task requires identifying skill gaps and development needs
• The task involves succession planning or career pathing
• The task requires coaching or developing team members' capabilities
• The task involves workforce planning or talent allocation
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves managing projects or resources without people focus
• The user only performs their own individual work
• The task requires no decisions about other people's careers or growth
• The user coordinates tasks but does not develop people
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task coordinates people's work but involves no hiring, skill-gap, retention, or career decision.

confusions.boundary_rule: Talent management develops workforce capacity. Leadership guides people day-to-day.
confusions.example_task: Identify future team leaders and create a development path for them.
confusions.expected_labels: Talent management; Leadership and social influence

confusions.boundary_rule: Talent management plans development at organisational level. Teaching is direct skill transfer.
confusions.example_task: Design a company-wide mentorship programme for new graduates.

confusions.boundary_rule: Talent management allocates people for development. Resource management allocates resources for operational efficiency.
confusions.example_task: Plan staffing levels for the next quarter while developing junior staff.
confusions.expected_labels: Talent management; Resource management and operations

examples.task_text: Interview candidates for the new customer service associate positions.
examples.reason: Requires attracting and selecting people with right skills.
